leah: T-minus 30 until cutoff for hotfix-8472 — we need 2 signoffs to merge or we'll autobackout the cherry-pick. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8472 @sam @maria can you spare a quick look? CI is green but saw a kv-cache smoke flake earlier. plan: if not 2x by 21:00 UTC we abort and roll back the branch.
deploy-bot: CI checks: ✅ all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e)
jin: On call, can do a pass in ~10m. Ping me if you need an immediate handoff.
sam: Pulling the branch now, will run smoke and leave comments for any obvious problems.
maria: I can take a second signoff after smoke logs look clean. Will run kv warmup locally.
sam: Found one minor concurrency nit in store/kv_cache.go — suggestion: switch to atomic.AddInt64 instead of mutex in that hot path. Not blocking, but leaving note.
leah: Good catch, @sam — that should be fine to follow up in a patch, non-blocking for this cut. Timeout config stays at 5s.
jin: Pushed a tiny formatting fix and re-ran fmt. Force-pushed to the PR branch.
sam: Re-reviewed after fmt. Comments addressed. LGTM :+1: (non-blocking nit left about a comment string)
maria: Running smoke now: kv warmup succeeded, no OOMs. Logs look stable.
maria: LGTM — second signoff. :rocket:
leah: Merging now. Merge will trigger canary rollout, rollback window set to 15m. If we see >3% error rate revert automatically.
deploy-bot: merge action: merged PR #8472 by leah at 1705554570
jin: Thanks team — keeping eyes on canary dashboard. Will call rollback if anomalous metrics within window.
sam: Nice work — quick turnaround.
